title: BlockeMon
description: A curated Cobblemon SMP designed for those who prefer a peaceful, casual server with a genuinely friendly community! Perfect mix of Minecraft Vanilla and Cobblemon!
body:
The perfect blend of Minecraft and Cobblemon!

Jump into a world where Pokémon adventure meets Minecraft survival, with tons of exciting features designed to make every moment legendary!

What makes us special?
- Player-led server. The players are our number one priority and we take suggestions seriously! Everybody's ideas are valued and paid attention to. You want something added? We hear you!
- We have an active Owner to hang out, build, mine and battle your Pokémon with!
- We have a dedicated Event Host who always goes above and beyond in creating fun and engaging events - it never gets boring over here!
- It's all about the good vibes! 

Features Include:
🗺️ Beautiful Special Biomes & Structures
✨ Wild-Spawning Shinies, Mythicals and Legendaries!
🏘️ Claim & Build
🧠 Daily Trainer Battles
🗒️ Daily Community Tasks
🔍 Pokemon Hunts
🥚 Pokemon Daycare Breeding
🏆 Daily, Weekly, Monthly Leaderboards
💪 Over 1200+ Wild Trainers
⚡ Mega-Evolutions & Type-Z Moves
🏅 Weekly Events 
💰 Trading & Economy
🫂 Friendly Community & Active Staff
